tasks.label: android: 单元测试挂起等待调试器

background.beginsPattern: Starting a Gradle Daemon|Downloading|Task :app:|Welcome to Gradle
background.endsPattern: Listening for transport dt_socket at address: 5005

tasks.label: android: 构建并安装 debug APK
tasks.command: export ANDROID_SERIAL="$("${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/adb_target.sh")"; [ -n "$ANDROID_SERIAL" ] || { echo '无法确定唯一调试设备，已中止'; exit 1; }; echo "目标设备：$ANDROID_SERIAL"; ./gradlew :app:installDebug --console=plain

tasks.label: android: 启动应用并等待进程
tasks.command: export ANDROID_SERIAL="$("${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/adb_target.sh")"; [ -n "$ANDROID_SERIAL" ] || { echo '无法确定唯一调试设备，已中止'; exit 1; }; echo "目标设备：$ANDROID_SERIAL"; adb -s "$ANDROID_SERIAL" shell am start -W -n com.miaotoujunshi.chat/com.jev.probe.MainActivity || { echo 'am start 失败，最近日志：'; adb -s "$ANDROID_SERIAL" logcat -d -t 100 | tail -40; exit 1; }; for i in $(seq 1 40); do pid=$(adb -s "$ANDROID_SERIAL" shell pidof com.miaotoujunshi.chat | tr -d '\r' | awk '{print $1}'); if [ -n "$pid" ]; then echo "应用进程已就绪：pid=$pid"; exit 0; fi; sleep 0.25; done; echo '应用已启动但进程没有存活，最近日志：'; adb -s "$ANDROID_SERIAL" logcat -d -t 100 | tail -40; exit 1

tasks.label: android: 转发 JDWP 端口 (8700)
tasks.command: export ANDROID_SERIAL="$("${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/adb_target.sh")"; [ -n "$ANDROID_SERIAL" ] || { echo '无法确定唯一调试设备，已中止'; exit 1; }; pid=$(adb -s "$ANDROID_SERIAL" shell pidof com.miaotoujunshi.chat | tr -d '\r' | awk '{print $1}'); if [ -z "$pid" ]; then echo '找不到 com.miaotoujunshi.chat 的进程：先启动应用，并确认它没有崩溃。'; exit 1; fi; adb -s "$ANDROID_SERIAL" forward tcp:8700 jdwp:$pid && echo "调试通道已就绪：localhost:8700 -> pid $pid（设备 $ANDROID_SERIAL）"
